column1: # Seconds each knife script took (crate knives cells, GitHub macos-latest): `<seconds>\t<path>`.
# Read by `aib-xtask knife-shards plan` to place the scripts over the cells; a script without a line
# weighs the median, so a new script needs no line. Made with `aib-xtask knife-shards secs <logs>`
# from runs 45027063373, 45059008650 and 45069694126 (11-22): per script the lower median of the three.
# The 79 scripts the macOS cells ran on #898 run 45701153697 (head e36264d867, attempts 1 and 2, 11-26) take
# that run's lower median instead (90856, ebab8 08:47: macOS 1/3 hit the 80-minute step limit twice; the old
# lines had 54 of them low and 25 missing). Lines of the Linux cells' scripts are as they were.
# knives-net-allow.sh had no green run there (its 84 is from 11-22, before it grew to 27 knives; attempt 2 cut it
# at its 5-minute limit after 22 knives in 301s): 380 est = 27 knives x ~13.7s, until a run measures it.
# The 98 scripts the four macOS cells finished on #900 run 45807336910 (head d347c5d86a, 11-26) take that
# run's seconds (90856; f163c 20:35: macOS 3/4 planned 3536 s from 19 estimated lines, ran over 4800 s and hit
# the 80-minute limit in knives-winlogin.sh). knives-winlogin.sh was cut there after 6 of its 8 knives in 66 s:
# 90 est. With these lines the 100 macOS scripts plan 4667 s over four cells, 3734 over five, 3069 over six.
